analysis_results.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on the Hugging Face dataset "EvaKlimentova/knots_AF". The dataset consists of protein amino-acid sequences with labels indicating knotted (1) vs. unknotted (0), in a CSV-like format with fields "id,sequence,label". The evaluation table indicates an overall dataset size of 39,412 proteins with 19,718 in the unknotted set, and also reports per-protein-family subset sizes (e.g., SPOUT 7,371; membrane 8,225; VIT 14,262). No additional details about data source provenance, train/validation splits, or preprocessing beyond tokenization are specified.
analysis_results.model_architecture: BERT-based sequence classification model fine-tuned from Rostlab/prot_bert_bfd (ProtBert-BFD). It uses a Hugging Face AutoTokenizer and AutoModelForSequenceClassification setup, where protein sequences are split into space-separated tokens prior to tokenization. Further architectural specifics (e.g., number of layers, hidden size, attention heads, parameter count, context length) are not provided in the card.
